metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.description: Add key-value pairs, these can be used for API integrations and also in flows.

allowTakeOver.label: Allow Takeover
allowTakeOver.description: If enabled, the resource can be taken over by other users without the current user having to release the resource. Has no effect when Max parallel sessions is greater than 1.

maxParallelSessions.label: Max parallel sessions
maxParallelSessions.description: How many people can use this machine at the same time, each with their own session (1–1000). With 1 (the default), only one person can use the machine at a time.
maxParallelSessions.belowActiveHint: {{count}} sessions are active right now, more than this limit. They keep running; new sessions can only be started once fewer sessions than the limit are active.
maxParallelSessions.flowsWarningTitle: Flows don't check the session count
maxParallelSessions.flowsWarning: Some flows that run for this machine (its own flow or global flows) react to every session start or stop, even while other people are still working, without checking how many sessions are active. A power-off flow can cut the power too early.

maxSessionTime.label: Max session time
maxSessionTime.description: The server stops a session automatically when it reaches this time. Leave both fields empty for no limit. Applies to sessions started afterwards; running sessions are not changed.

requireEstimate.label: Require duration estimate
requireEstimate.description: Starting a session asks how long the machine will be used at most. The machine stops automatically when that time is up; people can extend it while it runs. Stopping can switch the machine off (stop flows), so this can end long jobs such as 3D prints.

defaultEstimate.label: Default estimate for readers without a screen (minutes)
defaultEstimate.description: Readers that cannot ask for an estimate (headless readers, older firmware) start with this duration. Empty means 60 minutes.
defaultEstimate.tooLong: The default estimate cannot be longer than the max session time.

separateUnlockAndUnlatch.label: Separate Unlock and Unlatch
separateUnlockAndUnlatch.description: Can be useful if the door needs to be unlocked and the latch needs to be opened separately

accessOnly.label: Access only
accessOnly.description: The door has a single action, Open: it opens and closes again by itself. Lock and unlatch are not offered. Cannot be combined with "Separate Unlock and Unlatch".

retraining.description: Require users to be retrained after a period of time or inactivity. Leave a field empty to disable that trigger.

maxAgeDays.label: Retrain after (days since training)
maxAgeDays.description: Retraining becomes due this many days after a user was trained, regardless of usage.

maxInactivityDays.label: Retrain after inactivity (days)
maxInactivityDays.description: Retraining becomes due if the user has not used this resource for this many days.

blocksAccess.label: Block access until retrained
blocksAccess.description: If enabled, users lose access once retraining is due until an introducer retrains them.

supervision.description: Control who may start a usage session on this resource.

introduction_required.label: Introduction required
introduction_required.description: Only introduced users may start a session. This is the default behavior.

supervision_allowed.label: Supervision allowed
supervision_allowed.description: Introduced users may start a session on their own; users without an introduction may start one while a supervisor is present.

supervision_required.label: Supervision required
supervision_required.description: Every session requires a present supervisor, even for introduced users.

autoPromotion.description: Automatically grant an introduction after a user has completed enough supervised sessions.

threshold.label: Supervised sessions until introduction
threshold.description: After this many supervised sessions the user is auto-introduced. Leave empty to disable auto-promotion.

toast.title: Error Creating Resource
toast.description: Could not create the resource. Please try again.

toast.title: Error Updating Resource
toast.description: Could not update the resource. Please try again.
